name: binary_nulls
sql: SELECT CAST(NULL AS BINARY_DOUBLE) AS D, CAST(NULL AS BINARY_FLOAT) AS F FROM DUAL

name: zero
sql: SELECT 0d AS D, 0f AS F FROM DUAL

name: double_aggregate
sql: SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) AS TOTAL FROM (SELECT 1.25d AMOUNT FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 2.5d FROM DUAL)

name: float_aggregate
sql: SELECT SUM(AMOUNT) AS TOTAL FROM (SELECT 1.25f AMOUNT FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT 2.5f FROM DUAL)

name: wide_range
sql: SELECT 1e300d AS LARGE_D, 1e-300d AS SMALL_D, 1e30f AS LARGE_F, 1e-30f AS SMALL_F FROM DUAL

name: mixed_legacy
sql: SELECT 123456789012345678901234567890 AS N, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS N_NULL, 'text' AS T, DATE '2020-01-02' AS DT, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-02 03:04:05.123456' AS TS, 1.25d AS D FROM DUAL

name: limit_more
sql: SELECT CAST(LEVEL AS BINARY_DOUBLE) AS N FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL<=3

name: limit_exact
sql: SELECT CAST(LEVEL AS BINARY_FLOAT) AS N FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL<=2

name: empty
sql: SELECT 1d AS N FROM DUAL WHERE 1=0

name: double_nan
sql: SELECT BINARY_DOUBLE_NAN AS BAD_D FROM DUAL

name: double_inf
sql: SELECT BINARY_DOUBLE_INFINITY AS BAD_D FROM DUAL

name: float_nan
sql: SELECT BINARY_FLOAT_NAN AS BAD_F FROM DUAL

name: float_inf
sql: SELECT BINARY_FLOAT_INFINITY AS BAD_F FROM DUAL

name: unsupported_clob
sql: SELECT TO_CLOB('not supported') AS C FROM DUAL
